subject: Bash
reason: The card said POST to github.com with the quote state,mergeCommit. The command merged PR #124 and then sent a POST to api.oked.ai. The card built its title from bits of three steps. Now the title comes from the step that set the tier, and other risky steps are listed.

fields.Title: Merge PR #124 in aml11/oked-app
fields.Body:
gh pr merge https://github.com/aml11/oked-app/pull/124 --squash 2>&1 | tail -1
curl -s -w " %{http_code}\n" -X POST https://api.oked.ai/api/mobile/v1/auth/token -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d…
fields.Footnote: Other steps in this command need no approval

subject: Bash: gh pr merge
reason: Found while checking the PR #124 card: gh pr merge was safe, so a merge alone never asked you. A merge changes the base branch for everyone and often deploys. gh deletes and archives are high stakes too.

subject: Bash: gh pr comment
reason: GitHub writes that other people see (PR and issue comments, reviews, closes, releases, workflow runs, secrets) were safe. They now ask for review, like an email send. gh api writes are high stakes, like a curl POST.

subject: Bash: railway up
reason: Railway deploys were safe and the card only showed the raw command. A deploy changes a live service, so it is high stakes now, with the title Deploy to Railway.
